question_text: Six department heads—Finance, Health, Education, Public Works, Agriculture, and Tourism—are seated in a row at a municipal council meeting. The Finance head sits at one of the ends. The Health head sits immediately to the left of the Education head. The Public Works head sits second to the right of the Agriculture head. The Tourism head sits between the Finance head and the Agriculture head. Which department head sits at the opposite end of the row from Finance?
